title: Prerequisites
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM

You can use the transaction ETOUEXCEPTO1 (accessed from the SAP Easy Access Menu as follows: |»Utilities Industry > Billing
Time-of-Use Exceptions Monitor and Edit Time-of-Use Exceptions %) to monitor and edit time-of-use exceptions. You can also
use it to create, change, and delete TOU exceptions or their activation status. You can also navigate to the relevant TOU exception

program and the relevant TOU exception responses.

Prerequisites

To be able to create TOU exceptions, an appropriate TOU exception program is required. You create TOU exception programs in

Customizing for SAP Utilities: |}/Advanced Metering Infrastructure » Time-of-Use Interface » Define Time-of-Use Exception
Program

Features

You can select the TOU exceptions you want to monitor or edit using a combination of different criteria, such as a user name, a
specific period of time, an exception program ID, or an exception text. You can also restrict the number of TOU exceptions selected
by making an entry in the Restrict Number To field. For more information about the possible selection criteria and the
combinations available, see the documentation for the report REEXCEPTION DISP_MAINT.

Monitoring of TOU Exceptions

You can use the Change Layout function to add additional fields (such as administration data and texts). By selecting a line and
choosing |}Goto » Exception Response 3, you can navigate to the available TOU exception responses for the selected TOU
exception. Here, you can change or delete the responses, or you can change the activation status - see Monitor and Process Time-
of-Use Exception Responses.

Creating TOU Exceptions

The From/To time information is in the same time zone as the selected TOU exception program. You can determine the predefined

time period in the BAd| ISU_TOUEXCEPT_ TIME, method SET FROM TO DATE_TIME. If the activation category of the TOU
exception program is not Active for Individual Customers, the TOU exceptions may not overlap. In addition, a TOU exception must

be in the time period of the TOU exception program. The From/To time information must match the interval length of the
appropriate TOU interface.

1 Note

If the TOU exception program is not linked to a conditional billing program in Customizing, the check does not take place. Also
note that the system does not check whether the TOU exception period is part of a period that has already been billed for a
relevant installation.

When a TOU exception is created, the activation status is set to Active. You can determine the default status in the BAdI

ISU TOUEXCEPT STATUS, method SET ACTIVATION STATUS When you create a TOU exception, the activation status (Active
or Inactive) is set automatically.

Change TOU Exception

When you change a TOU exception, the system carries out the same checks that are carried out duing creation. You can only
change a TOU exception if it has not yet been billed. You can view all changes to TOU exceptions by selecting a line and choosing
Goto Change Document *¥. Note that the From/To time information is in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC). Also, the Text for
TOU Exception Program field is not entered in the change document.
